coastal.title: After nearly 2-month-long closure, Highway 1 through Fraser Canyon partially reopens
coastal.description: Following an almost two-month-long closure due to wildfires, Highway 1 has reopened to limited travel through the Fraser Canyon area, according to the B.C. Ministry of Transportation.

prince-george.title: New hatcheries will see up to 1 million more salmon raised and released into Fraser and Skeena Rivers annually
prince-george.description: "Salmon are not simply a resource," Lheidli T'enneh Chief Dolleen Logan said at the announcement held in Prince George Tuesday. "Salmon are relatives. They are a part of our culture, our identity, our laws, our responsibilities."

prince-george.title: Rosalyn Bird leaves Kerry-Lynne Findlay's B.C. Conservatives
prince-george.description: Rosalyn Bird, the MLA for Prince George-Valemount, is the latest MLA to leave the B.C. Conservative caucus. It comes on the heels of the departures of Ian Paton and Peter Milobar, who say they plan to set up a new political party.

prince-george.title: Dolly Parton's 'Jolene' may be named after British Columbia nurse
prince-george.description: A Prince George woman believes she may be the inspiration for the name in Dolly Parton's song Jolene. Juline Whelan met the singer in 1972 and matches the description of the little girl Parton says inspired the name behind the famous tune.

southeast.title: Wildfire north of Castlegar now mapped at 116 hectares
southeast.description: The B.C. Wildfire Service said helicopters were engaged to hold the fire through until rappel crews responded on Wednesday morning.

all.title: Wildland firefighters warned not to take supplements for smoke or PFAS exposure
all.description: A drug marketed to wildland firefighters exposed to smoke or PFAS shows no evidence of being effective, leading the International Association of Firefighters and the Food and Drug Administration to warn against its use. The drug, called glutathione, is marketed to fire fighters to remove toxins, but the IAFF says there are no scientific studies […]

all.title: Studying combined fuel treatments gives us a better picture of effectiveness
all.description: While many studies have established that fuel treatments are an effective wildfire mitigation tool, the gap in our understanding has been how a range of different treatments work together over many years across large areas to produce a desired outcome. all.title: Questions raised about B.C.’s approach to prescribed burns ahead of wildfire season
all.description: The prescribed burn was part of an 87-hectare risk reduction strategy, but the BC Wildfire Service has not yet confirmed whether the burn went ahead as planned.

all.title: 4th BC Conservative member quits party in past three days
all.description: This comes after Rosalyn Bird announced she was leaving the party on Tuesday, joining MLAs Ian Paton and Peter Milobar as recent defectors.

all.title: After devastating Summerland fire, B.C. faces call to 'cut red tape' for prescribed burns
all.description: As British Columbia grapples with wildfires of growing size and intensity, the province is facing calls to cut red tape to make conducting prescribed burns easier.
